# Athli

> Athli is an all-in-one coaching platform for fitness coaches to manage clients, deliver training programs, track progress, and grow their business.

Athli provides coaches with tools to build workouts, create training programs, track client habits and metrics, manage check-ins, automate onboarding, handle payments via Stripe, and communicate with clients through built-in messaging. It includes a coach web app, coach mobile app, and client mobile app.

## Documentation

- [Welcome to Athli](https://docs.tryathli.com/articles/welcome-to-athli): Introduction to the Athli coaching platform and what it offers.
- [Creating Your Account](https://docs.tryathli.com/articles/creating-your-account): How to sign up and set up your coach profile.
- [Inviting Your First Client](https://docs.tryathli.com/articles/inviting-your-first-client): Send your first client invitation and get started coaching.
- [Plans and Billing](https://docs.tryathli.com/articles/plans-and-billing): Overview of subscription plans and billing management.
- [Understanding Athli Plans](https://docs.tryathli.com/articles/understanding-plans): Detailed breakdown of Starter (free), Pro, and Max plans with features and pricing.

## Training

- [Workout Builder](https://docs.tryathli.com/articles/workout-builder): Create and edit workouts with the drag-and-drop builder, AI generation, supersets, and custom sections.
- [Section Builder](https://docs.tryathli.com/articles/section-builder): Build reusable workout sections (Regular, AMRAP, Tabata, HIIT, EMOM, Circuits) for your library.
- [Training Programs](https://docs.tryathli.com/articles/training-programs): Create multi-week structured training programs and assign them to clients.
- [Exercise Library](https://docs.tryathli.com/articles/exercise-library): Browse 1,700+ exercises with video demos, or create your own custom exercises.

## Client Management

- [Client Management](https://docs.tryathli.com/articles/client-management): Add, edit, archive, and organise your coaching roster.
- [Client Notes](https://docs.tryathli.com/articles/client-notes): Keep private notes about each client for tracking observations and session summaries.

## Forms

- [Check-ins](https://docs.tryathli.com/articles/check-ins): Create recurring check-in forms to collect regular client feedback and track trends.
- [Questionnaires](https://docs.tryathli.com/articles/questionnaires): Create one-time questionnaires for onboarding, assessments, or gathering specific data.

## Tracking and Progress

- [Habits](https://docs.tryathli.com/articles/habits): Assign and track daily habits with streaks and completion tracking.
- [Metrics](https://docs.tryathli.com/articles/metrics): Track weight, body measurements, and custom metrics over time with charts.
- [Progress Photos](https://docs.tryathli.com/articles/progress-photos): Capture and compare client progress photos side by side.

## Communication

- [Messaging](https://docs.tryathli.com/articles/messaging): Real-time chat with clients, file sharing, voice messages, and reactions.

## AI Assistant

- [AI Assistant](https://docs.tryathli.com/articles/ai-assistant): AI-powered coaching assistant that generates workouts, analyses client progress, and answers questions about your clients.

## Automation

- [Automations](https://docs.tryathli.com/articles/automations): Set up automated flows triggered by client activity.
- [Onboarding Flows](https://docs.tryathli.com/articles/onboarding-flows): Automate client onboarding with questionnaires, welcome messages, and habit assignments.
- [Business Sequences](https://docs.tryathli.com/articles/business-sequences): Build post-purchase automation workflows with visual flow editor, triggers, and actions.

## Business and Payments

- [Business Packages](https://docs.tryathli.com/articles/business-packages): Create and sell coaching packages with Stripe integration.
- [Coupons](https://docs.tryathli.com/articles/coupons): Create discount coupons for your coaching packages.
- [Managing Your Subscription](https://docs.tryathli.com/articles/managing-subscription): Change plans, manage add-ons, view invoices, and update billing.
- [Cancelling and Reactivating](https://docs.tryathli.com/articles/cancelling-reactivating): Cancel, reactivate, or delete your account.

## Files and Productivity

- [Files](https://docs.tryathli.com/articles/files): Upload and share documents and files with clients.
- [Todo List](https://docs.tryathli.com/articles/todo-list): Manage tasks with automated and personal task tracking.

## Account and Settings

- [Settings](https://docs.tryathli.com/articles/settings): Configure your account, profile, notifications, and app preferences.
- [Refer and Earn](https://docs.tryathli.com/articles/refer-and-earn): Earn rewards by referring other coaches to Athli.
